parts.name: Fan
parts.Basic_description: This is one of the internal fan blades of the tower fan, made of lightweight plastic for efficient airflow.
parts.Functional_description: It rotates to generate airflow and circulate air through the fan housing.
parts.Movement_description: It rotates around its central axis when powered by the motor.

parts.name: Fan
parts.Basic_description: This is another internal fan blade assembly, identical to the first, made of durable plastic.
parts.Functional_description: It assists in maintaining consistent airflow and pressure within the tower fan.
parts.Movement_description: It rotates in synchronization with the other fan blades to produce a steady air stream.

parts.name: Fan
parts.Basic_description: This is the third fan blade unit, made of plastic, forming part of the vertical airflow system.
parts.Functional_description: It contributes to the overall air output and cooling efficiency of the fan.
parts.Movement_description: It rotates continuously during operation, driven by the internal motor shaft.

parts.name: Base Body
parts.Basic_description: This is the base body of the tower fan, made of ABS plastic, providing structural support and housing for internal components.
parts.Functional_description: It supports the fan assembly, contains the motor and control electronics, and ensures stability during operation.
parts.Movement_description: It remains stationary, serving as the main structural and functional housing for the fan.
